title: Hasil Skenario Uji Signed SBOM S01-S03

cases.description: Kontrol: rilis dan SBOM sah, SHA-256 pada SBOM sama dengan artefak rilis
cases.command: digisign sbom check --file test/sbom/results/S01/contoh-app.zip --bundle test/sbom/results/S01/contoh-app.bundle.json --sbom test/sbom/results/S01/contoh-app.cdx.json --sbom-bundle test/sbom/results/S01/contoh-app.cdx.bundle.json --trust-store test/sbom/results/S01/trust.json --package contoh-app --version 1.0.0 --json

cases.description: Isi SBOM diubah setelah ditandatangani: satu karakter SHA-256 komponen diganti, ukuran tetap
cases.command: digisign sbom check --file test/sbom/results/S02/contoh-app.zip --bundle test/sbom/results/S02/contoh-app.bundle.json --sbom test/sbom/results/S02/diubah/contoh-app.cdx.json --sbom-bundle test/sbom/results/S02/contoh-app.cdx.bundle.json --trust-store test/sbom/results/S02/trust.json --package contoh-app --version 1.0.0 --json

cases.description: Artefak rilis diganti dan ditandatangani ulang dengan kunci sah, SBOM lama tetap dipakai
cases.command: digisign sbom check --file test/sbom/results/S03/diganti/contoh-app.zip --bundle test/sbom/results/S03/contoh-app-diganti.bundle.json --sbom test/sbom/results/S03/contoh-app.cdx.json --sbom-bundle test/sbom/results/S03/contoh-app.cdx.bundle.json --trust-store test/sbom/results/S03/trust.json --package contoh-app --version 1.0.0 --json
